page.content:
Seven-time champion who built Ferrari's modern dynasty.

How Michael Schumacher connects

  • Faction: Scuderia Ferrari — Michael Schumacher won five straight titles with Ferrari.
  • Item: World Drivers' Championship — Schumacher's seven Drivers' Championships reset the career standard.

What is Michael Schumacher?

Michael Schumacher won two titles with Benetton, then five in a row with Ferrari, breaking Fangio's record and making the early 2000s a scarlet procession.

Key threads lead to Scuderia Ferrari and World Drivers' Championship.
